technical-data.invention-title: ANTIBODY AGAINST GLYCERYLALDEHYDE-3-PHOSPHATE DEHYDROGENASE AND UTILIZATION THEREOF
ANTICORPS CONTRE LA GLYCERYLALDEHYDE-3-PHOSPHATE DESHYDROGENASE ET SON UTILISATION

nplcit.text: ISHITANI R. ET AL.: 'Nuclear Localization of Overexpressed Glyceraldehyde-3-Phosphate Dehydrogenase in Cultured Cerebellar Neurons Undergoing Apoptosis' MOLECULAR PHARMACOLOGY vol. 53, no. 4, April 1998, pages 701 - 707, XP002926104

SUNAGA K.: 'Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate Dehydrogenase is Over-expressed during Apoptotic Death of Neuronal Cultures and is Recognized by a Monoclonal Antibody Against Amyloid Plaques from Alzheimer's Brain' NEUROSCIENCE LETTERS vol. 200, no. 2, 1995, pages 133 - 136, XP002926105

abstract.p: A novel monoclonal antibody against glycerylaldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH) and a hybridoma strain NCK-J24 producing this antibody. The monoclonal antibody produced by the above hybridoma selectively and strongly recognizes GAPDH, which makes it usable in screening a protein participating in apoptosis, diagnosis and preventing and/or treating nerve degeneration diseases (Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's diseases, Parkinson's syndrome, Huntington's disease, Machado-Joseph disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease, etc.) and diseases in which GAPDH participates (for example, spinal cord injury, spinal cord compression, cerebral ischemia, motor function disorder caused by peripheral nerve injury, etc.).

L'invention concerne un nouvel anticorps monoclonal contre la glycérylaldéhyde-3-phosphate déshydrogénase (GAPDH) ainsi qu'une souche hybridome NCK-J24 produisant cet anticorps. L'anticorps monoclonal produit par l'hybridome précité reconnaît sélectivement et fortement GAPDH, ce qui le rend utile dans le criblage d'une protéine participant à l'apoptose, le diagnostic et la prévention et/ou le traitement de maladies de dégénérescence nerveuse (la maladie d'alzheimer, la maladie de Parkinson, le syndrome de Parkinson, la maladie de Huntington, la maladie de Machado-Joseph, la sclérose latérale amyotrophique, la maladie de Creutzfeldt-Jakob, etc.) et des maladies auxquelles la GAPDH participe (par exemple des maladies de la moelle épinière, la compression de la moelle épinière, l'ischémie cérébrale, les troubles de la motricité provoqués par des lésions des nerfs périphériques, etc.).
